title: CapsuleMalware: Hierarchical Feature Learning for Multi-Dataset Malware Classification via Dynamic Routing

contributions.mechanism: depthwise 可分离卷积+ghost 模块
contributions.evaluation: 声称降参最多 60%,但正文 Results 未实测(仅评 baseline)
contributions.domain: 恶意软件图像分类/胶囊网络
contributions.source_quote: Lightweight capsule architectures using depthwise separable convolutions and ghost modules, reducing parameters by up to 60% while maintaining accuracy

contributions.mechanism: margin loss + focal 分量 + 有效样本数类权重(β=0.99)+ 加权采样 + margin/CE 组合(0.7/0.3)
contributions.evaluation: BIG2015 不平衡比 >100:1 下 macro F1 92.48%
contributions.source_quote: Class imbalance solutions combining margin loss with focal loss components and weighted sampling for imbalanced malware datasets

contributions.purpose: 跨数据集评测 baseline 胶囊网络
contributions.source_quote: CapsuleMalware attains 91–98% accuracy and up to 94% macro F1 while reducing parameters by as much as 60%

self_declared_provenance.quote: our approach adapts focal weighting to capsule vector lengths, providing more appropriate handling of capsule-specific decision boundaries
